question: What is the annual retention rate of legislators who began their first term between January 1, 1917 and December 31, 1999, measured as the proportion of this cohort still in office on December 31st for each of the first 20 years following their initial term start? The results should show all 20 periods in sequence regardless of whether any legislators were retained in a particular year.
sql:
WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id_bioguide, 
           CAST(SUBSTR(term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as first_term_year
    FROM legislators_terms 
    WHERE term_number = 0 
      AND term_start >= '1917-01-01' 
      AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
year_range AS (
    SELECT 1 as rel_year
    UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 
    UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 
    UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10 
    UNION ALL SELECT 11 UNION ALL SELECT 12 UNION ALL SELECT 13 
    UNION ALL SELECT 14 UNION ALL SELECT 15 UNION ALL SELECT 16 
    UNION ALL SELECT 17 UNION ALL SELECT 18 UNION ALL SELECT 19 
    UNION ALL SELECT 20
),
cohort_years AS (
    SELECT c.id_bioguide,
           c.first_term_year,
           yr.rel_year,
           c.first_term_year + yr.rel_year as abs_year
    FROM cohort c
    CROSS JOIN year_range yr
),
retained AS (
    SELECT cy.id_bioguide,
           cy.rel_year,
           cy.abs_year,
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt 
               WHERE lt.id_bioguide = cy.id_bioguide
               AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= DATE(cy.abs_year || '-12-31')
               AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= DATE(cy.abs_year || '-12-31')
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_retained
    FROM cohort_years cy
)
SELECT 
    rel_year,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(is_retained) / COUNT(*), 2) as retention_rate_pct
FROM retained
GROUP BY rel_year
ORDER BY rel_year

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id_bioguide, 
           CAST(SUBSTR(term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as first_term_year
    FROM legislators_terms 
    WHERE term_number = 0 
      AND term_start >= '1917-01-01' 
      AND term_start <= '1999-12-31'
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_cohort
    FROM cohort
),
retained AS (
    SELECT c.id_bioguide,
           CAST(SUBSTR(c.first_term_year, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as first_term_year,
           CAST(r.term_end AS DATE) as term_end_date,
           CAST(r.term_start AS DATE) as term_start_date,
